raw_content.text: Hey Rowan! Are you still up for the ridge trail on Saturday? I was thinking we start around nine before it gets hot, then grab tacos at that place near the trailhead you mentioned. Bring the good camera if the fog burns off — the view from the saddle should be great this time of year. Let me know and I'll pack accordingly.
raw_content.subject: Saturday hike + lunch after?
